title: GitLab has remediated an issue in GitLab CE/EE affecting all versions from 18.10 before 19.4.11, 19.5 before 19.5.9,…
description: A vulnerability in GitLab CE/EE versions from 18.10 before 19.4.11, 19.5 before 19.5.9, and 19.6 before 19.6.2 allowed authenticated users with fine-grained personal access tokens to read work items in projects or groups beyond the token's granted permissions due to incorrect authorization checks. The issue has been remediated in the specified fixed versions.
